div.div: 10 استرغد العَيْشَ He found life to be ample in its means or circumstances, unstraitened, or plentiful, [and easy,] and pleasant. (Har p. 657.) One says, اِنْزلْ حَيْثُ يُسْتَرْغَدُ العَيْشُ [Alight thou where life is found to be ample in its means &c.]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
